summary: 20-year-old Western Colorado University student Sarah Thurlow found deceased in the Taylor River near mile marker 16 below Taylor Reservoir; abandoned Prius at the scene matched a Loveland missing-persons report; county swift-water team recovered the body lodged against a rock outcropping ~4:30 p.m.; no foul play suspected, investigation ongoing
location: Taylor River near mile marker 16, below Taylor Reservoir, Taylor Canyon
responding_agency: Gunnison County Sheriff's Office (deputies + county swift-water team)
notes: Run-896 CBN 2015+ sweep insert; CBN article dated 2021-01-20 reports incident 'Thursday, January 14' = 2021-01-14 (weekday-verified); parent-opened live 2026-09-18
